# Binding-preserving substitution and its exact position criterion

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For the supplied finite typed-term language, substitution and context assignments, every consumer evaluates equally before and after replacement iff each replacement term supplies the ground at its original position. Constructed substitution retains positions under nested binders; single insertion and successive substitution satisfy the corresponding semantic equations.

Canonical source: [InferentialSubstitution.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/InferentialSubstitution.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Uses existing InferentialGrounds finite terms, types and evaluation, with the same atomic carrier family and stable binding positions; no mutable state, divergence or physical cost.
- The all-consumer scope includes direct use of every position. Assessment preservation additionally requires a hypothetical guarantee and an actual producer satisfying its input criterion; substitution does not prove either premise.

Introduction, position, use and substitution are analytical roles within one derivation. The equations preserve the selected denotation; actual reference, full content and source-history correspondence remain obligations.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Actual Lean 4.29.1 compilation: 9 new theorems plus 10 inherited declaration audits, 19 total: 13 empty and 6 only Quot.sound through function extensionality. No custom axioms, proof holes, warnings or classical choice. Author counterreview and primary-method comparison; no independent acceptance or new empirical experiment.

The language and interpretation of binding remain supplied; presuppositionless grounding of metalogic is unfinished. Denotational equality alone does not establish identity of reference, content or history. No physical double execution, cost preservation or uniqueness of this calculus for all reasoning is proved.

- A same-type capture of an inner position can change the answer; equal current values can conceal the capture. The all-consumer condition is not necessary for an individual consumer that ignores that position.
